unsure.why: No start event or giver for the opening is in these files. That it starts right after Storn's death comes from the journal text.
Where you find and read Waking Dreams isn't recorded. An earlier quest script holds that book, but whether it's handed to you isn't shown.
No real reward is recorded. The script's 'Word Chest' item looks like a visual effect. Miraak's mask isn't tied to this quest in these files.
Frea and the two workers are in the quest, but these files don't show what they do. Miraak is placed in a holding cell, not a real spot.
No record says where Storn reads the book; Storn is placed in the Shaman's Hut, so that is the likely spot, not a confirmed one.

quests.canDoWhy: A random encounter: Miraak's cultists find you while you travel in Skyrim and attack, and you can search them afterwards.

starts.where: out on the road in Skyrim
starts.how: They come to you while you travel; nobody gives this quest.

people.name: Cultists (up to three)
people.role: attack you; one carries a note

unsure.why: The encounter has a note and a 'search' objective, and 'Dragonborn' starts with a cultist attack and a note, but no record ties the two together. The link is likely, not confirmed.

It fires from game events (nine priority nodes for Dragonborn world encounters). TimingIsEverything.esp, Requiem.esp, the Requiem Dragonborn patch and LoreRim - Global Modifiers.esp all edit it, but the extract doesn't show what level or timing they set.
The objective names the body to search with a placeholder; the cultists' names aren't in these files.
